propositions: Debug skill must write back findings at four lifecycle points: Phase-1-exit RCA comment, Reporting summary, not-a-bug classification, and Step-7 sibling ticket creation, with discovered_from linkage encoded directly in the skill.

Own-tracker (project's mandated tracker) writebacks bypass approval gates; third-party tracker mutations remain gated, with explicit carve-out added to approval-gate paragraph to prevent contradiction.
Step-7 sweep operates on two axes: construct-pattern recurrence (existing) and parallel-surface parity siblings (new), triggered by OR condition, each running under its own trigger.

Step-7 parity axis enforces 4-question artifacts: NAME THE RULE (operation+property, no site names), CHANNEL CENSUS (5-slot checklist: CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction), PER-SURFACE PROBE (path:line or MISSING), DISPOSITION (RED-test fix or ticket filing).

Reporting must include residual-risk disposition item with forced outcomes per citation: ticket filed with optional structural guard, accepted with reason, fixed in scope, or 'none observed' legitimate.
